name: Breezy HR
summary: Breezy HR charges a flat monthly price per plan with unlimited users and positions: $157, $273 or $439 a month when billed annually, or $189, $329 and $529 when billed monthly. A 14-day trial needs no card, and AI credits, texting and onboarding are separate add-ons.

facts.text: Breezy's features page says it advertises open positions on 50+ top job sites with a single click.
Interviews are scheduled from the candidate profile, where the scheduler can check interviewer availability and choose whether team members complete a scorecard after each interview.
Custom scorecards are available on the Growth, Business and Pro plans.
Breezy's terms say plans renew automatically for another term of the same length unless cancelled first, and they do not include a refund policy.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: $189 a month when billed monthly. The page does not label the two figures; the lower one fits its 'two months free' annual offer. Unlimited users and positions.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: $329 a month when billed monthly. Adds up to 5 locations per position.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $529 a month when billed monthly. Adds one-way candidate video up to 5 minutes.

plans.name: Custom Pro
plans.notes: Includes a dedicated account manager. API access and data export or import are optional extras.

hiddenCosts: Breezy Intelligence credits start at $30 for 100,000 credits.
SMS texting credits start at $41 a month and the Onboard add-on starts at $49 a month.
API access, advanced reporting and data export or import are offered only on Custom Pro, with no prices listed.

contract.cancellation: Plans renew for another monthly or annual term unless cancelled before the renewal date through Breezy's cancellation process. The terms do not describe that process.
contract.dataExport: The terms do not address export or return of data on termination.
